summary.headline: Vikran Engineering H1 FY27 standalone revenue rose about 27% to ₹424.12 crore and PAT about 71% to ₹25.37 crore, but EBITDA margin fell to 11.3%.
summary.overview: Standalone revenue grew about 26-27% YoY in H1 FY27 and PAT rose sharply, but Q2 standalone EBITDA margin compressed to 9.1% from 14.4% as escalated direct costs were expensed immediately while price-variation revenue awaits client certification. Consolidated Q2 PAT fell to ₹2.75 crore from ₹9.12 crore, with the gap attributed to the NOPL solar subsidiary, which has not yet booked revenue at scale because disbursement was delayed. Management said ₹13-16 crore of non-NOPL price-variation revenue is pending and expects most certification in H2. The NOPL solar project began commissioning, with about 90 MW commissioned out of 969 MWac and financing of ₹2,941 crore from IREDA at 9.15% now available.

segments.name: Power transmission and distribution (T&D) / substation EPC
segments.commentary: Commissioned a 132 kV transmission line in Arunachal Pradesh for PowerGrid (about 40.6 km, 138 tower foundations) and a 400 kV substation at Malerkotla ahead of schedule, described as the first process-bus substation for PowerGrid in India. Won two PowerGrid orders worth about ₹120.69 crore and ₹153.76 crore.

segments.name: Solar EPC (NOPL, Maharashtra)
segments.commentary: 152-location project with 969 MWac (about 1,163 MWp) and EPC contract value of about ₹3,517 crore, executed across eight clusters. About 18 sites / ~90 MW commissioned; a further ~100 MW is in advanced stages, expected in the next couple of months. Solar EPC is a fixed-price contract.

segments.name: Solar power sales (NOPL)
segments.commentary: Revenue from power sales has started; management expects about ₹42.5-50 crore in H2 FY27 and peak annual sales above ₹500 crore at full capacity. Free cash flow of about ₹100 crore a year was indicated at peak, with EBITDA margin of roughly 85-88% quoted for the project.

guidance_outlook: FY27 standalone revenue guidance of about ₹2,300 crore; management said H2 needs about ₹1,875 crore, with ~₹850-900 crore targeted in Q3 and the balance in Q4.
Consolidated revenue guidance of ₹950-1,000 crore for FY27 (per call), with power sales revenue on top.
EBITDA margin guided at about 14-15% for FY27 (management said ±1%), with price-variation certification expected mostly in H2.
NOPL: about 35-40% commissioning targeted by year end; completion expected by end Q1 FY28, with possible spillover into Q2 FY28.
Interest cost guided at ₹18-23 crore per quarter for Vikran (about ₹70-75 crore for FY27), with NOPL interest at 9.15% capitalised during construction.
Debtor days expected to fall by about 40-50 days versus last year as solar and other short-cycle projects scale; management said the company will remain cash positive throughout the year.
capex_capacity: NOPL solar: about 18 sites / ~90 MW commissioned out of 969 MWac; ~100 MW in advanced stage; management targets about 500 MW commissioning in FY27.

NOPL project financing: IREDA long-term facility of ₹2,941.19 crore against estimated project cost of ₹4,201 crore, at 9.15%; disbursement tied to cluster progress and expected shortly (management said before next week).
Solar module procurement: orders placed and capacity blocked; about 10-15% of land (around 10%) not yet identified, which management said is manageable.
Capital work-in-progress of about ₹740 crore, mainly NOPL-related, expected to be capitalised in H2 FY27 as commissioning proceeds.
International renewable platform being set up to co-invest with large investors while Vikran holds a minority stake and retains EPC; management said it hopes to share news by the next earnings call.
demand_pricing: Recent PowerGrid orders: ₹120.69 crore (Balodha and Rajaswari 400 kV service station package) and ₹153.76 crore (400 kV substation package, Tungkur 2 Puring).
Order book is about ₹6,200 crore, of which roughly 30% is from T&D, mostly substation EPC; management expects T&D margins similar to peers at roughly 15-16%.

Price-variation clauses cover power and water projects; solar NOPL is fixed-price. Management said only a small share of costs is not covered by pass-through, though some items not covered (affected by crude-linked costs amid West Asia tensions) saw significant increases.
Data centre opportunities: management said it is largely declining, pursuing only high-margin, urgently required projects.
Non-NOPL price-variation revenue of about ₹13-16 crore is pending certification (mainly MP and Maharashtra projects).

qa_highlights.question: Is the EBITDA margin hit from non-NOPL price variation, and will the pending revenue add to EBITDA next quarter?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said about ₹13-16 crore of non-NOPL price-variation revenue is unrecognised for MP and Maharashtra projects and should flow through when certified; margins expected around 14-15% for FY27.

qa_highlights.question: What solar revenue and cash flow should be expected in H2 FY27 and from NOPL at peak?
qa_highlights.answer: Power sales of about ₹42.5-50 crore expected in H2 FY27 from roughly 200 MW; at full operation, about ₹100 crore a year of free cash flow was indicated, with EBITDA margin quoted at around 85-88% for the project.

qa_highlights.question: Can FY27 revenue of ₹2,300 crore be achieved given ₹424 crore in H1?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the Q2 target was ~₹500 crore (₹200 crore non-NOPL plus ₹100 crore NOPL) and the shortfall was NOPL-driven; it plans ₹850-900 crore in Q3 and the balance in Q4, calling it achievable.

qa_highlights.question: Why did Q2 margins fall and what is the impact of NOPL on standalone?
qa_highlights.answer: Escalated direct costs on non-NOPL projects were expensed immediately while price-variation claims await client certification; NOPL contributed about ₹7 crore revenue in Q2 standalone, and NOPL overhead drag was estimated at ₹10-15 crore or less, unconfirmed.

qa_highlights.question: What is the interest cost outlook and why did finance costs rise?
qa_highlights.answer: Interest guided at ₹18-23 crore per quarter for Vikran, about ₹70-75 crore for FY27; finance costs rose due to funds infused into NOPL, and NOPL loan interest will be capitalised during construction.

qa_highlights.question: Will the company be cash positive, and how will debtor days trend?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the company is already cash positive and will remain so; debtor days are expected to fall 40-50 days versus last year, with about ₹200 crore reduction in debtors already achieved.

qa_highlights.question: What is the status of the 2,941 crore NOPL loan disbursement and its effect on execution?
qa_highlights.answer: Disbursement was delayed, so the company held back panel dispatches (about 60-65% of cost) to avoid overexposure; it expects disbursement within about a week and will accelerate execution.

risks_watch: NOPL disbursement from IREDA (₹2,941.19 crore) timing: management expects it within about a week, but panel dispatches (60-65% of cost) and execution depend on it.
Price-variation certification from clients: ₹13-16 crore non-NOPL revenue pending, with most expected in H2 FY27; delay keeps Q3 margins under pressure.
FY27 standalone revenue target of ~₹2,300 crore requires ~₹1,875 crore in H2 (₹850-900 crore in Q3); Q2 standalone revenue was short of the ~₹500 crore internal target.
Input cost risk from crude-linked items amid West Asia tensions; management flagged steel as a possible risk if it rose 30-40%, though it does not expect this soon.
Consolidated PAT and interest cost: consolidated Q2 PAT ₹2.75 crore; Vikran interest guided at ₹18-23 crore per quarter; NOPL interest capitalised during construction.
Solar execution milestones: ~90 MW commissioned out of 969 MWac, ~100 MW further in advanced stages, ~500 MW targeted for FY27; about 10% of land not yet identified.

summary.management_tone: Management was confident on FY27 revenue, margin (about 14-15%) and cash positivity, and on NOPL disbursement being imminent. It was noticeably vague on quantified items: it did not have the NOPL overhead drag figure ready, gave NOPL EBITDA margin only as a rough 85-88%, and deferred several specifics to later email follow-up.

adds.what: NOPL solar project, 969 MWac (about 1,163 MWp) across 152 locations; about 90 MW commissioned so far, ~100 MW in advanced stage
NOPL solar: target about 500 MW commissioning in FY27 (about 35-40% commissioning by year end); completion expected by end Q1 FY28

growth.why: Management guides FY27 standalone revenue above ₹2,300 crore (H2 needs ~₹1,875 crore, ~₹850-900 crore in Q3), backed by a ~₹6,200 crore order book and NOPL solar commissioning (~90 MW done, ~100 MW advanced), though H2 ramp depends on NOPL financing disbursement and price-variation certification of ₹13-16 crore.
